diagnostics.message:
This assignment reads x, so the compiler treats it as an update of x (a relative write, as in the deprecated old SC syntax).
Write it as x += 2 to say so. In one region it means the same.
It only matters when another region also writes x in the same tick: this assignment then runs after that write instead of conflicting with it.
